name: ChrisPirillo/ready-steady
description: Test your reflexes in this Game Boy-style quick-draw duel. Wait for the BANG signal and fire first to win. Play solo or challenge a friend in 2P mode!

name: ChrisPirillo/pyroclastic
description: An immersive procedural fire simulator with customizable physics, volumetric shaders, and generative audio. Design, randomize, and export 4K visuals.

name: ChrisPirillo/pool-party
description: Experience stunning real-time volumetric raymarching. Customize fractal complexity, distortion, and colors to create unique abstract 4K wallpapers.

name: ChrisPirillo/plasma-globe
description: Experience a stunning interactive plasma globe. Customize electric filaments, bloom effects, and core gases in this high-fidelity WebGL simulation.

name: ChrisPirillo/other-oceans
description: Explore infinite generative spaces with Other Oceans. A WebGL2 playground for creating, customizing, and exporting high-resolution procedural fractal art.

name: ChrisPirillo/messy-text
description: Transform normal text into chaotic, glitched art with this Zalgo generator. Control distortion levels and copy messy text for social media or designs.

name: ChrisPirillo/meeting-cost
description: Calculate the financial impact of meetings in real-time. Input hourly rates for attendees to see exactly how much money is being spent every second.

name: ChrisPirillo/magnetic-poetry
description: Create and share beautiful poems with digital fridge magnets. Choose from 40+ themes, customize colors, and export your creative writing as images.

name: ChrisPirillo/magic-8ball
description: Consult the void with this realistic 3D Magic 8-Ball. Tap to shake the icosahedron die and reveal your destiny with immersive neon visuals.

name: ChrisPirillo/luxstranded
description: Explore an infinite, evolving procedural tunnel using real-time WebGL raymarching. Customize parameters, randomize patterns, and export 4K wallpapers.

name: ChrisPirillo/lava-lamp
description: Experience a relaxing 3D raymarched lava lamp with customizable colors, speeds, and shapes. Play online free. Design your perfect vibe today.

name: ChrisPirillo/lattice-pray
description: Explore Lettuce Pray, an interactive neural lattice visualizer. This web-based application uses raymarched trigonometric density studies to create immersive, evolving geometric structures in real-time.

name: ChrisPirillo/laser-cursor
description: Configure and generate a custom, high-visibility laser cursor bookmarklet for your browser. Design a reticle overlay to ensure you never lose your mouse pointer again.

name: ChrisPirillo/infinity-cubes
description: Explore a real-time, raymarched Menger sponge fractal tunnel. An interactive WebGL visualization featuring customizable speed, rotation, and color palettes.

name: ChrisPirillo/holonet-uplink
description: Holonet Uplink aggregates Star Wars news, podcasts, and RSS feeds from dozens of galactic sources into a single real-time dashboard with filtering, search, and audio playback.

name: ChrisPirillo/fractal-mantle
description: A real-time WebGL fractal visualization tool. Explore infinite geometric variations with this interactive raymarcher and export high-resolution 4K wallpapers directly from your browser.

name: ChrisPirillo/feeling-salty
description: Explore 'Feeling Salty', a high-fidelity procedural cubic crystallization simulator. Generate realistic Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) visuals of salt-like structures with adjustable lighting, textures, and geometry.

name: ChrisPirillo/embroidery-lab
description: Transform digital images into realistic embroidery simulations with Embroidery Lab. A browser-based WebGL tool for creating thread, stitch, and Aida cloth textures in real-time.

name: ChrisPirillo/diamond-studio
description: A professional-grade physically based rendering (PBR) tool for gemological analysis. Visualize diamond cuts, clarity, color, and optical physics in real-time 3D.

name: ChrisPirillo/cyber-horizon
description: A procedural synthwave horizon generator. Create retro-futuristic 80s landscapes with neon grids, sunsets, and cityscapes in your browser.

name: ChrisPirillo/cat-scratch
description: Cat Scratch is a reactive ASCII organism living in your browser. Hunt, purr, and play with this interactive digital toy.

name: ChrisPirillo/blob-snob
description: Blob Snob is a real-time, interactive WebGL raymarching experiment. Manipulate procedural gyroid structures, color palettes, and animation speeds in your browser.

name: ChrisPirillo/bad-kanban
description: Experience the frustration of corporate project management in this satirical Kanban simulator. Features resisting cards, auto-scrambling layouts, and endless buzzwords.
